atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for XAUUSD (SCALPING). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=3.009, trend_persistence=0.267, mean_reversion=0.733. Learned timeframe weights: M5 (w=+0.249), H4 (w=+0.227), H1 (w=+0.204). Ablation-retained features: bos_breakout (w=+0.268), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.241), fvg_impulse (w=+0.215), sentinel_news_sentiment (w=+0.142) (pruned/left out by ablation: ema_trend, rsi_momentum).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for XAUUSD (SCALPING): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=3.009, mean-reversion=0.733). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to M5 (w=+0.249), H4 (w=+0.227), H1 (w=+0.204). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [bos_breakout (w=+0.268), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.241), fvg_impulse (w=+0.215), sentinel_news_sentiment (w=+0.142)] and pruned [ema_trend, rsi_momentum].
